preconditions.description: The input must be a string.

postconditions.expression: all(c in s for c in stdout)
postconditions.description: All characters in the output list must be present in the input string.
Each character in the output list must appear an odd number of times in the input string.

postconditions.expression: len(stdout) == len(set(c for c in s if s.count(c) % 2 == 1))
postconditions.description: The output list must contain all unique characters that appear an odd number of times in the input string.
